newsitems.title: Total War: SHOGUN 2 - Complete Edition announced to release in October
newsitems.contents: Total War: SHOGUN 2 - Complete Edition arrives October 13th bringing the classic back with some fresh modern touches. Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2026/09/total-war-shogun-2-complete-edition-announced-to-release-in-october/
